name: Automatically refresh the TUI when Data Root files change
description:
## Problem
With the Rowbly TUI open, creating a Story through the CLI does not update the TUI. External changes remain invisible until the affected screen is reloaded or Rowbly is restarted.

## Goal
Add a file watcher for the active Data Root so that changes made through the CLI, another Rowbly instance, or an external file update automatically refresh the relevant TUI data.

## Acceptance criteria
- Creating a Story through the CLI while the TUI is open makes it appear automatically on the relevant Board without manual refresh or restarting.
- File creation, modification, deletion and renaming anywhere in the active Data Root trigger updates to affected visible data, including Stories, Boards, configuration and enabled Plugin data.
- Changes to a currently displayed Story or Plugin view appear automatically; deleted records are handled gracefully.
- Refreshes preserve navigation, selection where the selected record still exists, and unsaved form input.
- Bursts of filesystem events are coalesced. Rowbly atomic writes and its temporary lock and journal files do not cause refresh loops or expose partially written data.
- The watcher handles newly created directories, is cleaned up on exit or Data Root changes, and does not accumulate duplicate watchers.
- Watcher or reload failures are surfaced without crashing the TUI, and subsequent valid changes can refresh successfully.

## Verification
Run the TUI and mutate the same Data Root with CLI commands: create, edit, move and delete a Story, then change configuration and enabled Plugin data. Confirm updates appear automatically and navigation and unsaved input remain usable. Verify rapid consecutive changes and watcher cleanup.
